Title: A settings value is changed, kept after reloading and restored
Step Action: Open the settings page of the row (System Administration menu).
Step Expected: The page opens with its heading.

Step Action: Change the field of the row to the new value.
Step Expected: The field shows the new value.

Step Action: Save (page Save button, row Save link, or leave the box for Administration Charges).
Step Expected: The save completes without an error page.

Step Action: Open the page again and read the field.
Step Expected: The field shows the new value.

Step Action: Put the original value back.
Step Expected: The original value is stored.

Title: An invalid settings value is not kept
Step Action: Open the settings page of the row.
Step Expected: The page opens with its heading.

Step Action: Note the current value of the field.
Step Expected: The original value is visible.

Step Action: Type the invalid or empty value in the field.
Step Expected: A validation indicator is shown or the value is rejected.

Step Action: Try to save.
Step Expected: The save does not complete.

Step Action: Open the page again and read the field.
Step Expected: The field shows its original value.

Title: Cancel discards a typed settings value
Step Action: Open the settings page of the row.
Step Expected: The page opens with its heading.

Step Action: Note the current value of the field.
Step Expected: The original value is visible.

Step Action: Type a new value in the field.
Step Expected: The field shows the typed value.

Step Action: Click Cancel.
Step Expected: The edit is discarded.

Step Action: Open the page again and read the field.
Step Expected: The field shows its original value.

Title: Distributions search finds nothing for an unknown value
Step Action: Open Distributions > Search.
Step Expected: The search page opens with its tabs.

Step Action: Open the Sample Number tab.
Step Expected: The Sample Number box and Search button are shown.

Step Action: Type ZZ-NO-SUCH-VALUE in the Sample Number box.
Step Expected: The box accepts the text.

Step Action: Click Search.
Step Expected: The search completes without a server error.

Step Action: Read the result area.
Step Expected: The page shows There are no Results to Display.

Title: Participant Address Labels search finds nothing for an unknown value and limits input length
Step Action: Open Distributions > Participant Address Labels.
Step Expected: The page opens with the Lab Code, Lab Name and Contact Name search boxes.

Step Action: Check the maximum length of the search box of the row.
Step Expected: It accepts at most 8 (Lab Code) or 50 (Lab Name, Contact Name) characters.

Step Action: Type ZZ-NOSUCH in that search box.
Step Expected: The box accepts the text.

Step Action: Click Search.
Step Expected: The search completes without a server error.

Step Action: Check the page after the search.
Step Expected: The Participant Address Labels page is still shown.

Title: Exports menu links open their page without an error
Step Action: Open Manage Contracts > Exports.
Step Expected: The Exports menu opens with four export links.

Step Action: Click the export link of the row.
Step Expected: The export page starts to open.

Step Action: Wait for the page to load.
Step Expected: The page loads.

Step Action: Check the page content.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Step Action: Check the page heading.
Step Expected: A heading is shown.

Title: A tabulation waiting for sign-off can be opened from Results Sign-off
Step Action: Open Results Sign-off.
Step Expected: The list of tabulations ready to be signed off is shown.

Step Action: Check the list has a View link.
Step Expected: At least one View link is shown.

Step Action: Click the first View link.
Step Expected: The tabulation page starts to open.

Step Action: Wait for the page to load.
Step Expected: The page loads.

Step Action: Check the page content.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.
